Clear memery with help garbage collector it's right

Q: How to get key names from JSON using jq A:

echo '{"ab": 1, "cd": 2}' | jq -r 'keys[]' prints all keys one key per line without quotes.

ab
cd

Q: How to use `jq` to obtain the keys A:

you can get the keys at the root of the json:

cat a.json | jq keys

you can also pipe json into the keys function:

cat a.json | jq ".data[] | keys"

Q: Flutter web app built with --web-renderer=html does not work on Safari until one clicks "Allow WebGL in Web Workers" A:

This was happening only when using color gradients in text using the code from here: Gradient Text in Flutter. I removed the color gradients and now the app works.
